issues.description: The template implementation of construct_zero_state_prep_circuit initializes a stim.Circuit using an integer argument (circ = stim.Circuit(offset)), which conflicts with the usage in the solution (circ = stim.Circuit()). This is a structural problem: passing an integer into the Circuit constructor is not the intended API usage in the solution and will confuse or block students running the template. The problem statement expects a circuit that prepares qubits at indices [offset, offset+n-1], but the template's constructor call suggests an incorrect type/usage for constructing the circuit.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, construct the circuit with circ = stim.Circuit() (no integer argument). Apply the offset by relabeling qubits before returning (as in the solution) or by explicitly documenting and implementing an offset-aware return (e.g., return a circuit whose qubit indices are shifted by offset). Update the template to match the solution's approach so students are not blocked by an incorrect constructor call.
